## Social Data Analytics · Cities · Energy · Environment

I am a graduate student in Social Data Analytics and Research at the University of Texas at Dallas. I am interested in using data, spatial analysis, and computational methods to understand how environmental and technological changes shape cities and everyday life.

My work sits at the intersection of **data science, GIS, environmental sustainability, and social inequality**.
